unsupported: The company began as a firewood supplier and has since expanded into mobile entertainment, lumber processing, and equipment distribution.

The business runs three main lines: a mobile axe-throwing trailer that travels to events across the region; a firewood operation supplying restaurants and residents; and a wood shop producing live-edge slabs and custom stair treads milled from hardwood and softwood trees harvested locally.

Customers include event planners seeking on-site entertainment, Bismarck-area restaurants buying cooking wood, custom home builders incorporating one-of-a-kind stair treads and slabs into Parade of Homes projects, and contractors needing skid-steer attachments.
Flatbed Firewood emphasizes sustainable sourcing, reclaiming urban trees from North Dakota boulevards for its stair treads and slabs.
